issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event paragraph (line 2) uses the identifier "AB-003" (confirmed to be a real acceptance-binding id in B-bf52 proofstory.json) with no definition of what the "AB" prefix means anywhere in background.md itself. A fresh reader with only background.md text has no way to resolve this reference at first appearance: the phrase "acceptance binding" is only introduced afterward (Key Insights / Solution Tradeoffs), and even then the text never explicitly states that AB-nnn is an acceptance-binding id (this ID-prefix convention is also undocumented in CLAUDE.md, only discoverable by reading proofstory.ts or B-bf52 artifacts). Non-blocking: later context (acceptance contract layer discussion) lets a reader retroactively infer the meaning.
